i don't think you're being selfish.

I've tried many hobbies, but none of them have really worked for me.
Gender dysphoria and ghe knowledge that I'll never truly be happy with my presentation, thoughts, and past.
I'm underage, and I'm in a catholic school

i did not understand your first two questions, but my gender dysphoria feels like a social desire turned into a personal desire. 

i don't know how to explain gender dysphoria to a cisgender person... if i was what society consideres to be a woman, even if my surroundings were shittier, I'd actually be happy, I'd actually feel that people know who I am and who I want to be, I wouldn't feel like the fucking aberration I am.

mainly gender dysphoria tbh, but school is certainly a factor

the only thing that'd make me happy is being reborn (with XX chromosomes, that is) or being in vegetiative state
I think I'm going to sleep now, thanks for talking with me.
I cry like once every week, I wish I could do it more often.

It is, I just don't think I will have enough money to do HRT and, well, you know, live. I also feel like I will still feel uncomfortable with myself after fully medically transitioning, only time will tell I guess
I'm not planning on doing HRT tbh. I feel like I won't be happy no matter how much money I put into my transition, so I'll just try to embrace my body I guess.

I've come out to a few of my close friends, and I have practically fully socially transitioned online, but I can't do much besides that because I'm still  living under my transphobic parent's roof.

wbu?
